name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, captivated by the raw power and intricate engineering of Formula 1 cars. He pursued a degree in aeronautical engineering at the Instituto Superior Técnico in Lisbon, channeling his passion into a formal education. After graduating, Ricardo spent several years honing his skills at smaller racing teams, gradually building his expertise in aerodynamics. His meticulous approach and ability to identify subtle performance gains quickly earned him a reputation as a rising star.

Before joining Manthey EMA, Ricardo was instrumental in developing several groundbreaking aerodynamic packages for a World Endurance Championship team. He is known for his data-driven approach, combining cutting-edge simulation techniques with real-world testing to optimize performance. His leadership style emphasizes collaboration and open communication, fostering a culture of innovation within his team. Ricardo is passionate about pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic design, constantly seeking new ways to improve downforce and reduce drag.

Ricardo stands out due to his relentless pursuit of perfection and his uncanny ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights. He has a knack for spotting opportunities that others might miss, often leading to significant performance improvements on the track. His dedication to his craft and his unwavering commitment to excellence make him a valuable asset to any racing team.
